name: Heritage
notes: Your original proportions, untouched
Surface smoothed one level
Translucent purple canopy as in the last Syn3h build
Dark centre stripe

name: Reference
notes: Pushed toward your studio renders
Shorter nose and tail, taller and rounder
Pinched waist, fuller rear haunches
Taller hoop spoiler
Dark glass teardrop canopy, no stripe, dark scoops

name: Speedster
notes: Long and low
Stretched nose and tail, dropped nose
Low canopy
Hoop spoiler flattened into a ducktail
Light stripe

name: Wide body
notes: Muscular: swollen front shoulders and rear haunches
Deep waist between the wheels
Wider hoop spoiler
Tucked belly for clearance
Dark scoops, bright stripe

name: Bubble
notes: Compact and tall, a moon buggy
Short nose and tail, inflated body
Tall clear bubble canopy
Narrower, taller hoop spoiler

name: Flared
notes: Wide body with a first step of flare over each wheel
Tail lights about 1.6 times larger

name: Cobra
notes: Tall rounded front fenders standing above the hood
Hood dropped into a valley between them
Strong rear haunches
Tail lights twice as large

name: Haunches
notes: Rear biased: very large rear haunches, modest front flares
Long swept tail lights wrapping round the rear corners

name: Coke bottle
notes: Deepest waist, so both pairs of flares read strongly from above
Tall tail lights

name: Extreme
notes: Everything turned up: the biggest flares front and rear
Deep hood valley
Wider hoop spoiler
The largest tail lights

name: Blade
notes: Linkage: one slim aerofoil blade, swelling where it meets the body
Body: a chrome collar the blade passes through
Tail lights: the original kite, half as large again, set in a chrome surround
Lower body drawn in beside each wheel so the linkage is in the open

name: Wishbone
notes: Linkage: twin arms spread at the body and joined at the hub, with a cross bar
Body: a dark recess with a chrome rim that takes both arms
Tail lights: three slanted bars each side
Lower body drawn in beside each wheel so the linkage is in the open

name: Coilover
notes: Linkage: a slim lower blade with a spring and damper standing above it
Body: chrome cone pods reaching toward the wheels, as in your studio renders
Tail lights: a long swept blade in a chrome surround
Lower body drawn in beside each wheel so the linkage is in the open

name: Space frame
notes: Linkage: an open frame of two spars with cross bracing
Body: deep dark pockets with a slim chrome edge
Tail lights: a large kite with a smaller one inboard
Lower body drawn in beside each wheel so the linkage is in the open

name: Delta
notes: Linkage: a stub delta wing, narrow at the wheel and broad at the body, with an accent spine
Body: paint coloured fairings that swell out to meet the wing roots
Tail lights: a full width bar joining two kites
Lower body drawn in beside each wheel so the linkage is in the open

name: A-arm
notes: Lower member: a broad A-arm, two deep arms and a web, about three times the old blade
One coilover from the arm to a tower raised from the fender
Tail lights: one rounded bar each side, inside the rear panel
Headlights: a domed lens in a chrome bezel over each nose duct, about twice the old lamp

name: Box arm
notes: Lower member: a heavy tapered box section with an accent rib
One large coilover to a fender tower
Tail lights: two slim stacked bars each side
Headlights: larger lens with a chrome halo ring

name: Twin shock
notes: Lower member: a large aerofoil arm, broad at the body
Two slimmer shocks per wheel, each to its own tower
Tail lights: a slanted bar in a chrome surround
Headlights: wide oval lenses

name: Fork
notes: Lower member: two thick tubes forking from the hub to the body, cross braced
One big coilover standing between them
Tail lights: a tall rounded lamp each side
Headlights: the largest lenses, with a halo ring
